Name: Lex Utility
Description: Utility starter plugin for Ulanzi DX200.

Actions.Name: Network Speed Test
Actions.Tooltip: Test download and upload speed with an Ookla Speedtest server.

Actions.Name: Web Latency Monitor
Actions.Tooltip: Monitor one HTTP/HTTPS URL and show live response latency.

Actions.Name: Pomowave
Actions.Tooltip: Pomodoro timer with sound cues and rhythmic breaks.

Actions.Name: Claude Usage
Actions.Tooltip: Show Claude subscription usage: weekly and 5-hour limits with reset countdowns. macOS only.

Actions.Name: ChatGPT Usage
Actions.Tooltip: Show Codex usage limits and reset countdowns from the Codex CLI.

Actions.Name: Bambu 3D Printer Status
Actions.Tooltip: Show live status, progress, elapsed time and remaining time for one Bambu Lab 3D printer.

Actions.Name: Synology NAS Status
Actions.Tooltip: Monitor one Synology NAS: online state, system temperature and volume usage.

Actions.Name: System Status
Actions.Tooltip: Show up to three live CPU, RAM, GPU, temperature, upload or download metrics.

Actions.Name: MicroBreak
Actions.Tooltip: Guide short eye, posture and movement breaks for long computer sessions.

Localization.Single click: start or cancel a manual s: Single click: start or cancel a manual speed test. Double click: pause or resume automatic speed tests. Long press: open Speedtest.net.
Localization.Single click: test immediately. Double c: Single click: test immediately. Double click: pause or resume monitoring. Long press: open the monitored URL.
Localization.Single click: start, pause, resume, or c: Single click: start, pause, resume, or confirm the next phase. Double click: perform the single-click action twice. Long press: restart a full focus session or skip a pending break.
Localization.Single click: refresh Claude usage. Doub: Single click: refresh Claude usage. Double click: same as a single click; the second refresh is limited by the cooldown. Long press: open the Claude usage page.
Localization.Single click: refresh Codex usage. Doubl: Single click: refresh Codex usage. Double click: same as a single click; the second refresh is limited by the cooldown. Long press: open the configured usage page.
Localization.Single click: refresh printer status. Do: Single click: refresh printer status. Double click: refresh once and open Bambu Studio. Long press: open the selected MakerWorld site.
Localization.Single click: refresh NAS status. Double: Single click: refresh NAS status. Double click: same as a single click; the second refresh is limited by the cooldown. Long press: open the DSM page on macOS.
Localization.Single click: refresh system metrics. Do: Single click: refresh system metrics. Double click: request two consecutive manual refreshes. Long press: open Activity Monitor or Task Manager.
Localization.Single click: start, pause, or resume a: Single click: start, pause, or resume a break. Double click: perform the single-click action twice. Long press: skip a due reminder or cancel the current break.
Localization.Each action instance independently selec: Each action instance independently selects any, mainland China, or overseas servers.
Localization.Ignore the automatic test period and run: Ignore the automatic test period and run at any time
Localization.When the end is earlier than the start,: When the end is earlier than the start, it is treated as the next day.
Localization.No selection: choose daily from all serv: No selection: choose daily from all servers in this region.
Localization.One server selected: always use this ser: One server selected: always use this server.
Localization.Fetching servers… If this takes too long: Fetching servers… If this takes too long, select Refresh servers.
Localization.No servers match this filter. Change the: No servers match this filter. Change the region or refresh the list.
